name: Spirit Spring
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: A spring of heaven-and-earth energy (灵泉) that yields primeval stones. Every Qing Mao clan built its village on one; whoever loses its spring loses its future.

name: Moon Orchid
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: Moon orchids (月兰花), whose petals feed the Moonlight Gu. A Moon clan without them has blades that will not cut.

name: Wild Boar
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: Wild boars (野猪) of the Qing Mao forests: pork for the boar Gu, tusks for the refiner. Strength clans count them like stones.

name: Jade
uniques: Guaranteed with Strategic Balance resource option

civilopediaText.text: Fine jade (玉石), the food of the jade-skin Gu and the price of every rank-two fusion. Both paths need it, so both paths fight for it.
Brewed wine (酒), drunk by villagers and by the Liquor Worm. Brewed in taverns, never found in the wild.
A dead Gu Master's inheritance (传承), unearthed and held: recipes, materials, insight. Whoever holds the ground holds the prize, so nobody holds it for long without a fight.
Pelts of Southern Border beasts, sold by caravans. The only comfort the mountain offers for free, once someone has killed for it.

Wild Deer (鹿肉), the basic food of the transformation path's Gu: deer meat feeds some Gu; the beast-shaped Gu of the transformation path take it here. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Southern Border; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Transformation Path branch (2), each Transformation Hall (1) and the Transformation Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Beast Milk (奶水), the basic food of the bone path's Gu: the Bone Spear Gu and the Spiral Bone Spear Gu live on milk. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Eastern Sea; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Bone Path branch (2), each Bone Hall (1) and the Bone Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Python Blood (蟒血), the basic food of the blood path's Gu: python blood is the best food of many blood-path Gu; fresh crocodile blood feeds the Blood Skull Gu. It grows in the Southern Border, and some in the Eastern Sea; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Blood Path branch (2), each Blood Hall (1) and the Blood Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Fine Iron (精铁), the basic food of the sword path's Gu: no canon food is named for the sword path's Gu; fine iron, the metal of the Fine Iron Bone Gu, feeds them here. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Western Desert; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Sword Path branch (2), each Sword Hall (1) and the Sword Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Old Blades (旧刀), the basic food of the blade path's Gu: the Sole Blade Gu lives inside a blade and eats it away. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Northern Plains; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Blade Path branch (2), each Blade Hall (1) and the Blade Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Rooster Iron (雄鸡铁), the basic food of the metal path's Gu: rooster iron lies in open-air beds and rings in the wind; the metal path's Gu eat it here. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Southern Border; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Metal Path branch (2), each Metal Hall (1) and the Metal Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Iron Ore (铁矿), the basic food of the weapon path's Gu: no canon food is named for the weapon path's Gu; the iron ore weapons are forged from feeds them here. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Western Desert; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Weapon Path branch (2), each Weapon Hall (1) and the Weapon Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Battlefield Bones (白骨), the basic food of the killing path's Gu: a rank-five Gu that outlived its master turned wild and fed on the white bones of a battlefield. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Northern Plains; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Killing Path branch (2), each Killing Hall (1) and the Killing Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Fire Charcoal (火炭), the basic food of the fire path's Gu: the Fire Charcoal Gu burns from within; the fire path's Gu eat charcoal here. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Southern Border; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Fire Path branch (2), each Fire Hall (1) and the Fire Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Dragonfish (龙鱼), the basic food of the water path's Gu: dragonfish meat is the most common food of immortal Gu. It grows in the Eastern Sea, and some in the Southern Border; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Water Path branch (2), each Water Hall (1) and the Water Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Lingzhi (灵芝), the basic food of the wood path's Gu: giant lingzhi can feed Gu. It grows in the Southern Border, and some in the Central Continent; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Wood Path branch (2), each Wood Hall (1) and the Wood Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Marsh Mud (泥浆), the basic food of the earth path's Gu: mud crabs swallow marsh mud and carry the Gruel Mud Gu's power. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Southern Border; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Earth Path branch (2), each Earth Hall (1) and the Earth Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Wind Knot Grass (风结草), the basic food of the wind path's Gu: the beastmen believed whoever unties wind knot grass is favoured by heaven; the wind path's Gu eat it here. It grows in the Southern Border, and some in the Northern Plains; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Wind Path branch (2), each Wind Hall (1) and the Wind Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Sand Gull Earth (沙鸥土), the basic food of the cloud path's Gu: ten thousand jin of sand gull earth feed the Connected Clouds Gu. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Eastern Sea; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Cloud Path branch (2), each Cloud Hall (1) and the Cloud Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Central Continent; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Ice Snow Path branch (2), each Ice Snow Hall (1) and the Ice Snow Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Light Path branch (2), each Light Hall (1) and the Light Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Shadow Path branch (2), each Shadow Hall (1) and the Shadow Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Star Path branch (2), each Star Hall (1) and the Star Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Illusion Peach (幻界桃), the basic food of the illusion path's Gu: the illusion-realm peach tree weaves illusions to guard itself; the illusion path's Gu eat its fruit here. Nine-Bend Dream Flower (九曲梦里花), the basic food of the dream path's Gu: the nine-bend dream flower is a dream-path Gu material. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Western Desert; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Dream Path branch (2), each Dream Hall (1) and the Dream Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Wolf Meat (狼肉), the basic food of the enslavement path's Gu: enslavement Gu Masters must feed their beast packs; a wolf pack's hunt yields wolf meat. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Southern Border; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Enslavement Path branch (2), each Enslavement Hall (1) and the Enslavement Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Time River Water (光阴河水), the basic food of the time path's Gu: the Years Flow Like Water Gu only drinks the water of the river of time. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Eastern Sea; a Spring Cave works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Time Path branch (2), each Time Hall (1) and the Time Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Nether Jellyfish (幽冥水母), the basic food of the space path's Gu: tens of thousands of nether jellyfish feed a travelling immortal Gu. It grows in the Eastern Sea, and some in the Central Continent; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Space Path branch (2), each Space Hall (1) and the Space Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Pearl Thread Water (珠线水), the basic food of the rule path's Gu: an immortal Gu soaks in pearl thread water, the saliva of immemorial water spiders, and stays fed for eighty years. It grows in the Eastern Sea, and some in the Central Continent; a Spring Cave works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Rule Path branch (2), each Rule Hall (1) and the Rule Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Flying Bear Flesh (飞熊血肉), the basic food of the phantom path's Gu: the Flying Bear Phantom Gu eats the flesh of desolate flying bears. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Southern Border; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Phantom Path branch (2), each Phantom Hall (1) and the Phantom Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Restriction Path branch (2), each Restriction Hall (1) and the Restriction Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Hound Dung (犬粪), the basic food of the luck path's Gu: the Dog Shit Luck Gu is fed with the dung of desolate hounds. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Western Desert; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Luck Path branch (2), each Luck Hall (1) and the Luck Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Brocade Cloud (锦绣云), the basic food of the heaven path's Gu: the Heavenly Secret Gu is fed with brocade clouds. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Western Desert; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Heaven Path branch (2), each Heaven Hall (1) and the Heaven Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Western Desert; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Qi Path branch (2), each Qi Hall (1) and the Qi Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Ash (灰烬), the basic food of the refinement path's Gu: the Ash Gu lives on ashes; the refinement path's furnaces leave them. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Western Desert; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Refinement Path branch (2), each Refinement Hall (1) and the Refinement Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Star Cave Stone (星洞石), the basic food of the formation path's Gu: star cave stones lie under the arrow bamboo; formations are laid on them. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Southern Border; a Mine works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Formation Path branch (2), each Formation Hall (1) and the Formation Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Ginseng Whiskers (参须), the basic food of the pill path's Gu: ginseng whiskers feed the Earth Communication Ear Grass. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Southern Border; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Pill Path branch (2), each Pill Hall (1) and the Pill Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Old Scrolls (书卷), the basic food of the information path's Gu: the Bookworm eats books and maps and remembers them. It grows in the Central Continent, and some in the Western Desert; a Inheritance Dig works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Information Path branch (2), each Information Hall (1) and the Information Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Rice (稻米), the basic food of the human path's Gu: clans store rice for people beside the Gu's food. It grows in the Southern Border, and some in the Northern Plains; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Human Path branch (2), each Human Hall (1) and the Human Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Danqing Incense (丹青香), the basic food of the painting path's Gu: danqing incense feeds the Soul Swap Gu; its name is the painter's colours. It grows in the Northern Plains, and some in the Eastern Sea; a Plantation works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Painting Path branch (2), each Painting Hall (1) and the Painting Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.

Jade-Eye Monkey (玉眼石猴), the basic food of the theft path's Gu: killing jade-eye stone monkeys feeds the Jade Skin Gu; the thieving monkeys feed the theft path's Gu here. It grows in the Western Desert, and some in the Central Continent; a Camp works it. A clan gets it from each worked tile (1), the Theft Path branch (2), each Theft Hall (1) and the Theft Path Lore (1). It gives no happiness.
Heaven qi (天气) falls on the land a clan holds: 1 a turn for every 15 land tiles.
Earth qi (地气) rises from spring caves and hills: 1 a turn per spring cave and per 8 hills.
Human qi (人气) is gathered through people and deeds: 1 a turn per 10 citizens, and 5% of the damage your units deal.
Rank-six immortal essence (青提仙元). It never refills by itself: blessed lands make it, and a few immortal Gu, inheritances and trades.

Lifespan Gu (寿蛊) are made only by heaven and earth where life teems; nobody can refine one. Forests, jungles and swamps yield a few, as do some immortal Gu and inheritances. Reaching rank six, seven, eight and nine brings 20, 25, 35 and 60, and a higher rank burns them more slowly: one each 10, 15, 20 or 30 turns on Standard. With none left an immortal heals only by pillaging and wastes away (7 HP a turn). Civilopedia, Tutorials: Immortal Lifespan.

Ranked materials (仙材) from which immortal Gu are refined: 30 for a rank-six Gu up to 80 for rank nine, 60 for a Gu House. Blessed lands grow 1-2 a turn, a grotto-heaven 3; a slain desolate beast yields 20; Treasure Yellow Heaven buys a surplus for essence.
Rank-seven immortal essence (红枣仙元). Blessed lands of rank-seven immortals make it; rank-seven immortal Gu cost it.
Rank-eight immortal essence (白荔仙元), made by grotto-heavens; rank-eight immortal Gu cost it.
Rank-nine essence (黄杏仙元); even a Venerable runs short of it. Only a living Venerable makes it; Eternal Life costs 300 on Standard.
